body.purpose: Labels and actions that must remain familiar on macOS.

readout.purpose: Changing time and measurement values only.

motion.name: signal-shift

motion.name: island-morph
motion.purpose: Maintains physical continuity between compact and expanded states.

narrative.overview: Pulse behaves like a continuous instrument attached to the physical notch. A thin signal path, precise readouts, and calm tonal fields make compact and expanded states feel like one surface changing resolution.
keyCharacteristics: A continuous signal line connects state, navigation, and action.
Matte carbon surfaces with mineral-white type and one spectral user accent.
Native macOS typography, symbols, input behavior, and accessibility.
Tonal grouping replaces stacks of floating cards.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: On each surface, one accent owns the active path.

rules.name: The Single Object Rule
rules.body: The island is one shadowless silhouette; content inside it may not pretend to be separate windows.

dos: Do make the active state readable before exposing secondary controls.
Do preserve familiar macOS symbols and input behavior.
donts: Don't place every feature in an equal-weight rounded card.
Don't use glow, glass blur, or gradients as substitutes for hierarchy.
